Name: Replace Seb with human Seb from Pressure
Author: ShrapnelShard
Description:
How to install:

1) Make sure you have the required mods necessary to play modded stardew valley 

2) download the sebastian mod and unzip it 

3) drag and drop the mod into the mod folder in the stardew valley game file
(to locate this folder you can go to steam > right click the game > manage > browse local files > mods) 

4) MAKE SURE YOU CLICK ON THE SMAPI APPLICATION AND NOT THE REGULAR GAME OR ELSE THE MOD WONT WORK 



if anything seems off please comment below or dm me and i'll try to fix it right away

Downloads.Description:
Sebastian is a character from the Roblox game called Pressure.
The human design is from Canned Prawn.

This has sprite, portrait changes as well as bug fixes and some new dialogue sprinkled in.
